CHRONO_BOOST.name: Chrono Boost
CHRONO_BOOST.description: Spends energy to accelerate a target friendly structure's production or research. It needs useful work to accelerate and does not satisfy missing prerequisites.

STRATEGIC_RECALL.name: Strategic Recall
STRATEGIC_RECALL.description: Recalls eligible friendly units from a selected area to the Nexus after a delay. It competes for energy and has cooldown/selection constraints.

ENERGY_RECHARGE.name: Energy Recharge
ENERGY_RECHARGE.description: Transfers a burst of energy to an eligible friendly target through the newer Nexus support ability. Do not substitute the removed Battery Overcharge behavior from old guides.

RESTORE.name: Restore
RESTORE.description: Spends energy to replenish eligible friendly shields. Does not restore ordinary health; power, range, target rules, and available energy constrain support.

WARP_IN.name: Warp In
WARP_IN.description: Starts an eligible unit at a valid powered location and consumes that gate's production availability. The emerging unit can be attacked before completion.

CHARGE.name: Charge
CHARGE.description: Research unlocks a closing ability against an enemy ground target. It improves contact but does not give the Zealot a ranged weapon or access to aircraft.

BLINK.name: Blink
BLINK.description: Research unlocks a short teleport to a legal destination. Vision and terrain legality matter; it does not make all map points accessible.

PSIONIC_TRANSFER.name: Psionic Transfer
PSIONIC_TRANSFER.description: Sends a shade that can relocate the Adept when the transfer completes. The shade is not an independent damaging Adept; cancellation avoids committing to the destination.

FORCE_FIELD.name: Force Field
FORCE_FIELD.description: Spends energy to place a temporary movement blocker. Positioning can split armies or trap allies; Massive units and certain abilities can remove/bypass it.

GUARDIAN_SHIELD.name: Guardian Shield
GUARDIAN_SHIELD.description: Energy-based area protection against eligible ranged attacks. It is not universal protection against every spell or melee attack.

HALLUCINATION.name: Hallucination
HALLUCINATION.description: Creates temporary decoys usable for scouting and deception. They do not provide the combat damage or production value of real units.

PSIONIC_STORM.name: Psionic Storm
PSIONIC_STORM.description: Requires research and energy; damages an area over time. Friendly units can be harmed, and overlapping storms should not be assumed to multiply damage on one target.

FEEDBACK.name: Feedback
FEEDBACK.description: Uses an eligible enemy's energy against it and removes energy. An empty-energy target is different from a full caster.

ARCHON_MERGE.name: Archon Merge
ARCHON_MERGE.description: Consumes any two eligible Templar to create an Archon. The final unit does not retain the separate casters' energy or spell kits.

SHADOW_STRIDE.name: Shadow Stride
SHADOW_STRIDE.description: Researched teleport for repositioning. Its attack restrictions after arrival are version-sensitive; it does not bypass detection.

PURIFICATION_NOVA.name: Purification Nova
PURIFICATION_NOVA.description: Launches a controllable timed area attack. Travel, detonation timing, escape paths, and friendly fire determine the result; a Disruptor is not ordinary continuous-fire support.

PHASING_MODE.name: Phasing Mode
PHASING_MODE.description: Becomes a stationary power source for warp-ins and structures. Moving out of phasing mode removes that power.

LOAD_UNLOAD.name: Load / Unload
LOAD_UNLOAD.description: Transports eligible ground units; pickup and unloading depend on range, cargo capacity, and legal space. The Prism must survive with its cargo.

SURVEILLANCE_MODE.name: Surveillance Mode
SURVEILLANCE_MODE.description: Trades movement for a wider observation area. Concealment differs across balance versions; surveillance must not automatically be treated as invisible.

GRAVITON_BEAM.name: Graviton Beam
GRAVITON_BEAM.description: Channels to lift an eligible non-Massive ground target. The Phoenix is occupied channeling and needs another source of damage to exploit the lifted target.

PRISMATIC_ALIGNMENT.name: Prismatic Alignment
PRISMATIC_ALIGNMENT.description: Temporary weapon specialization against armored targets, with a mobility tradeoff. It does not turn every target into an armored target.

PULSAR_BEAM.name: Pulsar Beam
PULSAR_BEAM.description: Activates an energy-consuming ground weapon. It has no normal anti-air attack, and spending energy reduces remaining scouting/control options.

REVELATION.name: Revelation
REVELATION.description: Applies a temporary revealing/tracking effect to affected enemies. It is information tied to the effect and its duration, not permanent omniscience.

STASIS_WARD.name: Stasis Ward
STASIS_WARD.description: Places a trap that temporarily removes affected enemies from normal interaction. Stasised targets are not freely damageable; timing matters for follow-up.

BUILD_INTERCEPTORS.name: Build Interceptors
BUILD_INTERCEPTORS.description: Replenishes the small aircraft used for normal attacks. Interceptors cost resources and can be destroyed; an empty Carrier does not have a full independent weapon battery.

TIME_WARP.name: Time Warp
TIME_WARP.description: Applies area control to enemies within the effect. Delay, area, and target movement matter; it does not guarantee an engagement.

MASS_RECALL.name: Mass Recall
MASS_RECALL.description: Relocates eligible friendly forces to the Mothership under its recall rules. Distinct from the Nexus recall destination.

CLOAKING_FIELD.name: Cloaking Field
CLOAKING_FIELD.description: Conceals eligible nearby allies through the baseline's cloak ability. Do not assume the always-on cloak model from every older version.
